name: test-report
description: Results of a test run in green and red: pass/fail/skip counts, a bar, failures first with their messages, passing tests folded away. Pass the test command's output exactly as printed (cargo test, pytest -v, go test -v, jest, vitest, node --test, TAP, mix test, rspec). Use after running tests, instead of summarising them in prose.

text.description: The test run's output, as printed.

find.description: Fill the search box to show the user where something is.

title.description: Card title, e.g. what was run for.

command.description: The command, shown under the title.
